repositories_investigated.name: Princess Elisabeth Antarctica / International Polar Foundation (IPF)
repositories_investigated.findings: Technical microgrid system documentation exists (APMS PLC design, 54 kW wind, 72.5 kWp PV, 192 battery cells). However, raw downloadable time-series telemetry of electrical load P_load (kW) is NOT publicly published on open data portals for operational security reasons.

repositories_investigated.name: PANGAEA Data Publisher for Earth & Environmental Science (AWI)
repositories_investigated.findings: PANGAEA hosts extensive meteorological, glaciological, and Surface Energy Balance (SEB) datasets for Neumayer Station III. Terms like 'energy' refer exclusively to thermodynamic heat flux (W/m^2) at the snow surface. Zero operational station electrical power, generator load, or electrical demand time series exist on PANGAEA.

repositories_investigated.name: Norwegian Polar Data Centre (NPDC)
repositories_investigated.findings: NPDC hosts automatic weather station (AWS) meteorology for Troll Station and IPY deep radar traverse datasets. Terms like 'power' refer to scientific instrument specs (12V 55Ah gel battery powering radar electronics). Zero station electrical load, generator dispatch, or power grid telemetry datasets exist on NPDC.
